verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents native OpenTelemetry support. It ingests OTLP over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON, and apps already instrumented with OpenTelemetry can send data directly without a proprietary SDK. That means open-standard instrumentation carries over to Honeycomb unchanged. It also guides users off its proprietary Beelines and onto OpenTelemetry SDKs, which supports the instrument-once portability goal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of switching away from or between backends without re-instrumenting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of portability.
